## Functional summary

The 261-amino-acid sequence is an **exact full-length match** to reviewed UniProt protein **Q31FF5**, annotated as **3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate hydroxymethyltransferase** (EC 2.1.2.11; also called ketopantoate hydroxymethyltransferase).

- **Role and reaction:** It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a hydroxymethyl group from **5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate** to **3-methyl-2-oxobutanoate (α-ketoisovalerate)**, producing **ketopantoate** (2-dehydropantoate) and tetrahydrofolate.
- **Cellular process:** The enzyme participates in **pantothenate (vitamin B5) biosynthesis**, specifically ketopantoate formation. Pantothenate is a precursor for coenzyme A.
- **Subcellular location:** The reference annotation places it in the **cytoplasm**.
- **Additional annotation:** It binds **one Mg²⁺ ion per subunit**; the reference protein is annotated as a **homodecamer** (pentamer of dimers).

These assignments are strongly supported by the exact sequence match, though the localization, cofactor, and oligomer details are database annotations rather than measurements made on the supplied protein itself.
